title: Inspect research selection, acknowledgement and applied history
description: A developer uses the shipped CampaignResearch component and shared reducer-derived lab scenario. Browser playback is a component fixture, not live order admission, production delivery or authorization evidence. Both motion modes retain the same outcome; the existing service journey remains separate.

steps.description: Freeze browser playback only. The scenario calls the existing production reducers with its declared lab data; no campaign service or live account is invoked.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Inspect the pending research frame and compare both motion presentations.
steps.acknowledgement: Both component feedback panels report “Awaiting acknowledgement”.
verifications: Pending disables selection; recovery offers retry; accepted and applied orders remain distinct with the exact investing tick.
